summary: Silicon Valley resident, strong interest in web 2.0 companies and technology trends, background in mathematics (calculus and linear algebra), critical of wealth inequality and meritocracy, believes in the impact of IQ on success, advocates for cognitive screening in hiring, engaged in discussions about automation and job loss, skeptical of traditional education systems, follows stock market trends, particularly in tech startups, identifies with libertarian economic views, interested in the implications of social media on business models, critiques of subcultures and their evolution.
